headline: Ukraine and Russia report attacks on emergency alert apps
standfirst: Both countries say their official alert systems were compromised by digital threats.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Citizens in Ukraine received threatening notifications immediately after a Kherson ceasefire.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Russia and Ukraine have both reported unauthorized access to their public alert applications.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: These apps are vital for safety. Weaponizing them creates panic and undermines public trust.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for further verification on the source of these hacks and potential security updates.

caption:
Ukraine and Russia are reporting that their emergency alert apps have been targeted by cyberattacks.

In Kherson, residents were sent threatening messages right as a ceasefire period ended. Officials from both nations are investigating these security breaches. These apps are critical tools for survival during the ongoing conflict.
